attribution.name: 未署名
attribution.note: No writer or calligrapher is named on the stone.
attribution.noteZh: 碑上未署撰文者与书丹者姓名。

attribution.name: 王敞、王毕等
attribution.nameEn: Wang Chang, Wang Bi and others
attribution.note: Subordinate officials who paid for and erected the stone; not its authors.
attribution.noteZh: 碑阴所列捐资立碑的属吏，不是撰文或书丹者。

compositionDate.note: The current Beilin entry and Palace Museum agree on 185. An alternate Beilin entry gives 186.

backgroundZh: 碑为东汉曹全而立，今藏西安碑林。碑上留下了受颂者的姓名，执笔者却未署名。
background: An Eastern Han stele for the official Cao Quan, held at the Xi’an Beilin Museum. No scribe is recorded on the stone.
